name: The owner's own red pull request gets a round of the same task (AUTOFIX-1, 2, 3, 5, 7)
description: The owner's own task's pull request reads red at the head obid pushed: its first failure is run again once on GitHub, then the same job runs one more round in its session, with no follow-up and no card about red checks, the failed log quoted as data and none of it in a prompt; its conversation hears it's fixing them, then that its checks pass once the new head is green.
